plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Sections in New Releases (and mood/genre lists) now have their real names (Albums & singles, Music videos) instead of all being called "New Releases". New icon. "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu. Tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off. Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
